question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.
solution: The correct answer is **"Only".** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Only"** is the most appropriate option to fill in the blank. • It is used to emphasize that something is exclusive or restricted. • It can also be used to indicate that something is limited or restricted to a specific condition or situation. (केवल, सिर्फ़ (और कोई नहीं या और कुछ नहीं; किसी से अधिक नहीं)) • **Example**: *I was the **only__** woman in the room.* • In this context, using **"only"** indicates that there is a specific answer that is the most appropriate. • The correct answer is Option 3. • **Correct paragraph**: Literacy is a very important quality of a population. __**Only**__ an informed and educated citizen can make ______ (2) ______ choices and undertake research and development ______ (3) ______. Low levels of literacy are a ______ (4) ______ obstacle for economic improvement. In India, ______ (5) ______ has been a steady improvement in the literacy levels. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Option 1: **"One (एक, (संख्‍या) 1)"** is a numerical value and does not fit the context of the sentence. • Option 2: **"Who ((व्‍यक्ति का नाम आदि पूछने के लिए प्रश्‍नसूचक वाक्‍यों में प्रयुक्त), कौन?)"** is a pronoun and does not fit the context of the sentence. • Option 4:** "The"** is an article and does not fit the context of the sentence. 93:Td9e, The correct answer is **"intelligent."**
